name: Power Power Supply — 4.4V — QFN
description: Power supply and battery management components rated for 4.4V in surface-mount QFN-20 packages.
selection_hints: Confirm compatibility with the 4.4V facet specification.
Verify PCB land pattern matches the QFN-20-1EP 4x4mm 0.5mm pitch footprint with exposed pad.
Select between MCP73871-4CA and MCP73871-4CC variants based on system needs.
avoid_when: A voltage specification other than 4.4V is required.
The board layout requires through-hole mounting or a package family other than QFN.
The design cannot accommodate a QFN-20 package with an exposed pad.
